actual_trigger.not_supported_by_evidence: No thread-quota, allocator, TLS or stack corruption was proven as the source of this NULL ring.

implemented_contract.resolver: One exact new plural<16> imported symbol; no guessed template aliases.
implemented_contract.initializer: Existing InitializeTouchScreen now records touchReady under inputLock. Repeated initialization is idempotent and does not reset sampling.
implemented_contract.guards: NULL output first; negative/17+ capacity next; then explicit ready state. Invalid public calls stop through the existing runtime fatal policy rather than fabricating a Result or continuing the fault.
implemented_contract.zero_capacity: After explicit initialization, capacity0 returns0 and writes no bytes or sample-counter state. A non-NULL pointer is still required.
implemented_contract.positive_capacity: For1..16, return exactly one current Mac no-contact state. Sampling is nonzero/monotonic; contact count, reserved field and every touch byte are zero. Exactly0x290 bytes are written; all unused output states remain untouched.
implemented_contract.meaning: One available no-contact sample is distinct from zero available samples. No finger, mouse-derived touch, connected touch device, iOS touch support or game-input event is invented.
implemented_contract.counter: Dedicatedu64 touch counter under existing inputLock; no Npad/keyboard/legacy singular sampling counter consumption. Counter exhaustion stops explicitly.
implemented_contract.diagnostics: Only when CASTLEVANIA_DIAGNOSTIC_BOOT is enabled: one first-initializer witness and one first-successful-plural-sample witness with sample/contact count and656-byte ABI. No per-frame logging or raw payload.
implemented_contract.preserved: Legacy singular<1> implementation and Npad, keyboard, mouse, gamepad, controller mapping/shortcut behavior are unchanged.
implemented_contract.no_repair: No SDK global/shared-memory write, signal continuation, null fallback, allocator/TLS modification, original module rewrite or alternate initializer call.
